notes: FROZEN - no phases. gemini-cli 0.56.0 DOES raise blocking dialogs that name no tool call: the workspace-boundary read consent (checkPermissions parses @path at-commands out of the SUBMITTED prompt text and, for a path outside the workspace, renders a ConsentPrompt - 'The following files are outside your workspace: ... Do you want to allow this read?' - with submitQuery called ONLY from its onComplete, so no model call and no tool call exist while it blocks); the AdminSettingsChangedDialog settings review ('Admin settings have changed. Please restart the session to apply new settings.'); the FolderTrust / MultiFolderTrust first-use gates; and a further chain of tool-free dialogs in DialogManager (ProQuotaDialog, OverageMenuDialog, EmptyWalletDialog, ValidationDialog, PolicyUpdateDialog, LoopDetectionConfirmation, IdeIntegrationNudge, IdeTrustChangeDialog, the extension-update and confirm_action ConsentPrompts). Server-driven MCP elicitation is the one named trigger that is ABSENT: elicitation/create appears only as vendored @modelcontextprotocol/sdk schema, with no setRequestHandler(ElicitRequestSchema, ...) and no elicitation client capability anywhere in the bundle. The sandbox/network-access confirmation exists (type 'sandbox_expansion', title 'Sandbox Expansion Request', carrying a network flag) but is raised from ShellToolInvocation.shouldConfirmExecute or from a sandbox_expansion_required tool error, so an open run_shell_command carries both edges - it belongs to tool-gate-permission-prompt / permission-gate-non-mutating-tool, not here. NONE OF IT IS OBSERVABLE, and the citation is a one-member enum plus a one-caller producer: NotificationType has exactly one member ('ToolPermission') - the vendor's own docs/hooks/reference.md documents the field as ("ToolPermission") too - and fireNotificationEvent has exactly one caller in the whole bundle, fireToolNotificationEvent, which hard-codes that value and is itself called only from notifyHooks inside resolveConfirmation, the tool-confirmation loop. A dialog raised by no tool call therefore fires NO hook of any kind: not a mis-typed one the adapter drops, not a matcher-filtered one - none. The transcript is silent too: the Source is FilesUnderRoot over ~/.gemini/tmp/<project>/chats/*.jsonl, and for the primary trigger submitQuery has not run when the modal paints, so not even the user message is on disk; for a mid-turn dialog the confirmation is live React state and gemini persists tool calls only via recordCompletedToolCalls after resolution. And no classifier rung claims it - PermissionPending is hook-only, TranscriptPermissionPending is copilot's, NeedsUserAttention needs an open AskUserQuestion/ExitPlanMode, OpenToolStalled needs an open tool call which this row's premise excludes by definition, IdlePromptPending is claudecode's. Both edges are missing. INCAPABLE, NOT BUG - the claudecode contrast is the point: there the trace EXISTS (a Notification whose type defaults to permission_prompt, on a 6000 ms timer) and irrlicht discards it twice over, so the owner is irrlicht and a PR fixes it; here there is no trace to mishandle and no irrlicht change can make a hook that is never fired arrive. RE-ASSESS when gemini-cli adds a second NotificationType member or any fire site outside resolveConfirmation (then it is a one-line widening of handleNotificationHook's discriminator), or when it persists a pending-interaction record into the chat JSONL - weighed against the adapter's 2026-08-20 deprecation (PR #1725). A re-assessment must carry POSITIVE proof on both sides: a pane capture with the literal consent text AND evidence the hook receiver was reachable and logged zero Notification lines. Absence of a finding and inability to look must not produce the same output. NOT LIVE-CONFIRMED: this host cannot make gemini model calls (IneligibleTierError); the verdict is a source read of the 0.56.0 bundle and the adapter. The agent-side half is cheaply falsifiable even here, since the primary trigger raises its dialog with no model call at all.
